headline: The first pipelines move to serverless

items.title: uniware-sync runs on ECS Fargate
items.detail: Our biggest pipeline left its server. It now runs as a scheduled container behind a fixed IP that Unicommerce allowlists.

items.title: meta-sync live on Fargate
items.detail: Meta Ads spend and insights for both ad accounts load daily, with no NAT cost.

items.title: Sajid's invoice pipeline deployed
items.detail: Sajid Ali's Unicommerce invoice sync now runs inside our dbt staging and reporting layers, rebuilt every day.

items.title: B2B dashboards by Sajid
items.detail: Sajid built 4 B2B dashboards on top of it in Metabase: stuck invoices, master inventory, fill rate and daily run rate.

items.title: Landing zone for raw API data
items.detail: Every raw Unicommerce response is kept in S3 and moves to cheaper storage tiers after 30 and 180 days.

items.title: Courier scoring v2 and v3
items.detail: Shadowfax and marketplace couriers added, with a courier-level prior for scoring.

items.title: Data quality checks
items.detail: Fixed the Flipkart test and added a check for partial Unicommerce loads.

items.title: One owner per table
items.detail: Cleanup finished: every table has a single owner and scheduling moved to dbt.
